name: Agent Knock Knock
description: Control local Codex and Claude Code through shared tmux terminals, with live monitoring, approvals, and human takeover.

storeDir.description: Stable AKK Store root. Defaults to ~/.agent-knock-knock/store and contains the compatibility manifest and managed conversations.

openclawBin.description: Path to the OpenClaw CLI used by callback delivery. Defaults to PATH plus common user install locations.

codexHome.description: Optional CODEX_HOME path used to correlate Codex session metadata with eligible tmux terminals.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes an idle AKK session remains open before controlled reconciliation closes its managed-turn record. Defaults to 10080.

agentTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes without terminal activity or a coding-agent callback before AKK marks a managed turn stalled. Defaults to 60.

agentHardTimeoutMinutes.description: Fallback lifetime ceiling for a terminal bridge monitor that has not produced approval or completion. Defaults to 720 minutes.

autoApprove.description: Deterministic, default-disabled exact command-vector and workspace policy for terminal-controlled Codex and hookless Claude. Claude auto-approval also requires a current managed one-time Bash prompt with matching local transcript evidence. Policy configuration is trusted and never exposed as model-controlled tool parameters.

workspaces.description: One or more absolute workspace roots authorized by this automatic-approval rule.
